title: Lean 4 Formalization of Busch's and Gleason's Theorems
description: Neutral publication-facing release of the Lean 4 / Mathlib formalization of finite-dimensional complex versions of Busch's and Gleason's representation theorems. No Lean source file or theorem body is changed relative to the preceding scientific release. This snapshot provides stable publication metadata and a reviewer-facing citation target independent of any journal-specific naming.
